source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 13:19 (the Masorah's two)
claim_en: ki HASHBEA HISHBIA et-bene yisrael ('for he had SURELY SWORN the sons of Israel'): the doubled oath-verb stands ONCE in the Torah (adjacency checked), its only Scripture-twin SAUL'S honey-oath ('your father SURELY SWORE the people,' 1 Sam 14:28 — Jonathan condemned by an oath he never heard): the Kitzur — 'as HERE we expound: he made his brothers swear TO MAKE THEIR SONS SWEAR — so THERE he adjured even those not present; therefore Jonathan was caught although he did not hear it': the transitive oath — binding the unborn — read out of Joseph's doubled verb and priced by Jonathan's near-death; and in the same verse the corpus's oldest receipt lands: PAQOD YIFQOD elohim etkhem — 'God will SURELY VISIT you' (checked in-verse): gen_73's bones-oath, armed at Gen 50:25 across the book-boundary, PAYS — Moses carries the bones, and the settlement is authored at the fold.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 13:22 (the Masorah's two)
claim_en: LO YAMISH amud he-anan yomam ('the pillar of cloud shall NOT DEPART by day'): the not-depart frame stands exactly TWICE in the Torah (adjacency checked, both verified): the pillars here — and JOSHUA, 'his attendant, the youth Joshua son of Nun, DID NOT DEPART from within the tent' (Exod 33:11): the Kitzur — 'as the clouds RELIEVED one another (the fire rising while the cloud still stood — from lifne ha-am, not MI-lifne, asserted: at the seams BOTH stood before the people), so Joshua: rising early to learn by the pillar of fire's last light, staying late by the cloud's first — as the pillars never departed, JOSHUA NEVER DEPARTED — and therefore he merited to go before the people': the guidance-machinery of the exodus and the apprenticeship of its next leader, one verb-frame: the corpus arms the wire to 33:11.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:15 (the Hilleli; the Masorah's two; the Ramah, Minchat Kohen)
claim_en: va-yaharog YHWH kol-bekhor... MI-BEKHOR adam ve-ad bekhor behema ('FROM THE FIRSTBORN of man to the firstborn of beast'): the from-firstborn word written LEAN 'in the Hilleli copy and all precise books — ONE OF TWO lean by the Masorah, and its fellow: va-yehi ba-chatzi ha-layla OF THIS PARASHA' — the census verifies the pair EXACT (checked): the DEED-verse (12:29, the midnight strike) and the MEMORY-verse (here, the father's answer to the son) — the Torah's two lean from-firstborns, while the FORECAST stands full (11:5 mi-bekhor paro, with Num 3:46's redemption-count, asserted): the corpus files the grid: the plague announced in a full skeleton, performed and remembered in the thin one — the letter spending its vav before midnight and never restoring it.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:16 (the Ramah; the Masorah's 21; Rav Ashi in Menachot; Rashi; the Zohar-placement); Kitzur on 13:16
claim_en: ve-haya le-ot al YADKHA ('for a sign on YOUR HAND' — written ידכה with a final HE): the Ramah — 'bent kaf and FULL final he — and every other your-hand in the Torah lacks the he'; the census verifies the word Torah-UNIQUE (checked); the Masorah counts it among 21 words ending in כה and marks this one 'the second ve-haya-le-ot'; and Rav Ashi reads the extra letter as law (Menachot): YAD KEHA — 'the WEAK hand' — tefillin on the LEFT arm, from one final he (Rashi on the Torah so, at this very passage); MS's wonder preserved: the Zohar brings the derash at Vaetchanan's your-hand, 'and it is to be wondered at' (resolved by his Psalms rule, named); the Kitzur's crownlets named-only: FIVE TAGIN on the he — the five joints to the tefillin-place: the arm-sign's whole geography hung on one quiet letter.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:11 (the printer corrected; R. Yaakov of Beit Levi; the Beit Yosef's citation explained; the Ramah)
claim_en: ve-haya ki YEVI'AKHA YHWH el-eretz ha-kenaani ('when the LORD BRINGS YOU to the land of the Canaanite'): written LEAN in its second yod — and MS dismantles a phantom: 'the PRINTER ERRED who wrote ובאך with a vav and put yevi'akha in the margin as a qere — THERE IS NO KETIV/QERE HERE AT ALL' (the false apparatus annulled; R. Yaakov of Beit Levi ruled so in his responsa, and the Beit Yosef's tefillin-citation explained); the Ramah: 'yevi'akha — ONE alone in the Torah lean in the second yod, its sign THIS VERSE, and all the rest full': the census verifies the whole file (checked): the lean form only here — and the FULL form's four stations include 13:5 IN THIS SAME CHAPTER (the first when-He-brings-you full at verse five, the second lean at verse eleven — the chapter carrying both skeletons of one word six verses apart, with MS ruling 'the FIRST has no break here' beside it): the run's eighth corrected authority is the press itself.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:15 (Menachot's broken vav; the Agudah; the Mordekhai; the Masorah's four; the Ramah)
claim_en: va-YAHAROG YHWH kol-bekhor ('and the LORD SLEW every firstborn'): some books write it FULL — but the tradition proves it LEAN from the Talmud's strangest test-case (Menachot): 'the leg of a vav of va-yaharog split — bring a CHILD NEITHER WISE NOR FOOLISH: if he reads VA-YAHAROG (He slew), it is valid; if YEHAREG (He was slain — the blasphemy), it is invalid' — and the Tosafists: 'from here it follows va-yaharog has NO vav between resh and gimel' (else no broken-vav could look like the word); the Masorah's FOUR full slay-words (Amos's remnant, Esther's enemies, the sold-to-slay) counted WITHOUT it: the census verifies (checked): the lean form only here, the full form nowhere in the Torah — the verse where one broken letter is the line between the God who slew and the God who was slain, guarded by a child's plain reading.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:13 (the Hilleli; Berakhot's dream-chapter; Rashi, the Arukh, Sefer HaTerumah, the Ramah)
claim_en: ve-khol PETER CHAMOR tifde ve-se ('every FIRSTLING OF A DONKEY you shall redeem with a lamb'): the donkey-word LEAN 'in the Hilleli and all precise books' — and the tradition carries its proof in a DREAM (Berakhot, the chapter of dreams): Bar Hedya to Rava — 'the VAV of peter chamor is ERASED (gehit) in your tefillin' — Rashi: the scribe had written it FULL and then SCRAPED THE VAV OUT to correct it (the Arukh reading the same tale the other way, and MS ruling Rashi's reading primary with the Ramah: 'four donkey-language words lean in the Torah, one of them the tefillin-passage's'): the census shows the five thin skeletons of the letters chet-mem-resh across the Torah's four senses (checked — the redemption-donkey here, Issachar's strong-boned donkey Gen 49:14, with the bitumen, the wine, and the measure sharing the skeleton, asserted): a spelling ruled by a dream about a scribe's erasure, frozen in every mezuza-passage since.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:10 (the two-words derash); Kitzur on 13:10 (the Masorah's five)
claim_en: ve-shamarta et-ha-chuqa ha-zot LE-MOADAH MI-YAMIM YAMIMA ('you shall keep this statute AT ITS SEASON FROM DAYS TO DAYS'): the season-word FULL-vav and Torah-unique (checked) — MS: read it LAMO EDAH, 'TWO WORDS: A TESTIMONY is it to Israel, that the Name is called upon them' (the tefillin-verse's own word split into its witness); the Kitzur counting by the vav: six weekday-days bound to tefillin, six festival-days free; and the days-to-days pair BOTH Torah-unique here (checked) with the Masorah's five completed in the Prophets (named): Jephthah's daughter's yearly lament, Shiloh's yearly feast, Elkanah's yearly ascent, Hannah's yearly coat — the chain's law from the phrase: 'FROM days — not ALL days: excluding Sabbaths and festivals; and yamima by Jephthah's daughter — WOMEN, too, exempt from tefillin': one rare adverb carrying the tefillin-calendar and its exemptions.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:18 (the precise books; the Mekhilta; the Yerushalmi; Rabbenu Bachya); Kitzur on 13:18
claim_en: va-CHAMUSHIM alu vene-yisrael ('and ARMED the sons of Israel went up'): the shin RAPHE in precise manuscripts and the early print, and the word LEAN after the mem by the Masorah (checked: the qubbutz standing where the vav is not; the full skeleton absent from the Torah, asserted) — and around the thin word the chain's whole armory: the Mekhilta's descending count ('one in five went up — some say one in fifty — some say one in five hundred'), the Yerushalmi's 'armed with FIVE kinds of weapons,' the Kitzur listing them from the psalm (shield, buckler, spear, arrows, staff); and Rabbenu Bachya reading the missing vav as the destination: 'the Torah GIVEN AT FIFTY DAYS was the purpose of their going up — and a hint to the FIFTY times the exodus is mentioned in the Torah': the armed-word spelled like the number fifty, marching fifty days toward the mountain (the Sinai-clock armed at 19:1).

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:20 (the Ramah's whole booth-file)
claim_en: va-yisu MI-SUKOT ('and they journeyed FROM SUCCOTH'): lean in its last vav in all precise books — and MS unrolls the Ramah's WHOLE booth-grid: 'every sukkot-word — sukot, ba-sukot, mi-sukot — is lean-of-lean, EXCEPT TWO full in the last vav, their sign: ki VA-SUKOT hoshavti of Emor (Lev 23:43)... and Jacob's la-miqnehu asa SUKOT lean-of-lean, therefore he called the place's NAME Sukot; and chag HA-SUKOT unique lean-of-lean' — the censuses verify the grid across the corpus (checked: the from-Succoth pair exactly here and the itinerary's repeat Num 33:6; Jacob's verse carrying BOTH the booth-form and the name-form, asserted; the Emor station full): the station Israel leaves in this verse is spelled by the same rule-book that will spell the festival of booths — the geography and the holiday one thin file.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 13:15 (the Masorah's two)
claim_en: va-yehi ki-HIQSHA faro le-shalchenu ('and it was, when Pharaoh HARDENED against sending us'): the father's answer-script names the hardening as history — and the Kitzur's Masorah-pair (named): 'MI HIQSHA elav va-yishlam — WHO HAS HARDENED against Him AND PROSPERED?' (Job 9:4) — 'which the midrash expounds ON PHARAOH': the one Scripture that answers the seder-father's hardened-verb is the question that has no survivors; the stream's station checked in-verse (with the skeleton's Torah-spread asserted: SIHON'S hardened spirit Deut 2:30 — the next king hardened by Heaven — and the stiff-necked of Deut 31:27 sharing the thin form): the corpus files the catechism's grammar: the child asks why, and the answer is a king who hardened and did not prosper.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 13:3/5/12/15/17/18/19/21 (the letter-file); Kitzur (the remainder)
claim_en: The chapter's letter-file: va-YIQACH et-atzmot yosef — the qof of the bones-taking DAGESHED (checked: the verb hardened at the receipt-verse); BE-CHOZEQ yad (13:3) — the bet dageshed ('by STRENGTH of hand,' the exodus-formula's own letter ruled, asserted, with 13:16's twin); YHWH KOL-bekhor (13:15) — the kaf of kol DAGESHED 'by the mapiq-rule, and NO PASEQ between the Name and kol as some books have' (the false divider struck); ki qarov's kaf hard (13:17); derekh dageshed with the paseq ruled ON elohim (13:18); ve-haavarta (13:12) closing on a lengthener or mercha 'NOT a tevir,' with kol raphe beside it; la-nechotam (13:21) — NO lengthener in the lamed; the FIRST ki-yevi'akha (13:5) — 'NO break here' (the second false parasha struck this chapter) and its kaf soft; HOTZA'AKHA (13:9) lean-yod, its census-pair Deut 7:19 (checked at the build) — the Kitzur: 'with the TENTH plague He brought them out' (the missing yod as the count); VE-KHOL PETER twice adjacent only in this chapter (13:12-13, the firstling-law's own pair, asserted — Bekhorot's donkey-of-a-donkey rule named); VE-LAYLA doubled in 13:21 itself (asserted — the Kitzur's six across Scripture with the Sisera-wire: 'this night reveals knowledge to the night of Sisera's stars'); the pillars' seam (13:22 LIFNE ha-am, not MI-lifne — 'sometimes BOTH stood before the people,' asserted); and the Kitzur's ciphers named: et-ha-am = gam EREV RAV with the kollel (asserted at the build — the sent people already counting its multitude), the three tagin of u-netanah lakh, the five tagin of yadkha's he, the tefillin-gematriot (the left arm; the Shema in the mouth).
